properties.title: NRC Report: Unknown Material in Manayunk Canal near Philadelphia, PA
properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 809559 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: RICHARDSAPEX
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 809559
Incident Time: 2006-08-29 13:30:00
Nearest City: Philadelphia, PA
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: UNKNOWN MATERIAL
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: RICHARDSAPEX
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Sheen Size: 15 feet by 15 feet (area 225 sq. ft.)
Skytruth Minimum Possible Spill Volume: 0.01 gallons
CALLER STATES THAT ON AUG 7TH, A DISCHARGE ON-SITE OF 2,700 GALLONS OF MINERAL OIL OCCURRED AT FACILITY, AND WAS CONTAINED IN CONCRETE FACILITY AREA. WHEN RESPONDERS CAME ON-SITE, THEY CONCLUDED MATERIAL WAS INDEED, CONTAINED AND DID NOT REACH WATER. HOWEVER, AFTER A FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION, NOT ALL 2,700 GALLONS WERE ACCOUNTED FOR. MARKEDLY, A CRACK WAS FOUND BETWEEN THE WALL AND THE FLOOR (WHERE MATERIAL MAY HAVE BEEN POCKETED). NO ACTUAL MATERIAL WAS SEEN GOING INTO THE MANAYUNK CANAL AT THIS TIME. HOWEVER, ALGAE POCKETS WERE DISCOVERED BY A 3RD PARTY CONSULTANT WHO CHECKED CLEAN-UP AT THIS TIME. LARGE AMOUNTS OF THE ALGAE WERE DISCOVERED IN THE CANAL, AND IT WAS DETERMINED THAT HEAVY RAINS RAISED THE HEIGHT OF THE CANAL THE NIGHT BEFORE, WASHING THE ALGAE POCKETS DOWNSTREAM INTO ANOTHER WATER SOURCE. AT THIS POINT IN TIME, AN UNKNOWN MATERIAL IS BEING RELEASED INTO THE CANAL NEAR FACILITY AND IS CREATING A SMALL RAINBOW SHEEN IN THE WATER. THE MATERIAL APPEARS TO COME UP IN SMALL DROPLET-SIZED PUFFS EVERY 5-10 MINUTES, AND IS ONLY SEEN DISCHARGING DURING PRODUCTION AT THE FACILITY. CALLER STATES THAT MATERIAL MAY BE COMING FROM VIBRATIONS OF PRODUCTION, BUT SOURCE AND CAUSE FOR MATERIAL RELEASE IS UNKNOWN. ADDITIONALLY, CALLER STATES THE DISCHARGE MAY BE COMING FROM AN INTERNAL STORAGE TANK FARM UNDER BEDROCK, AS SHE BELIEVES IT WASN'T DUG TOO DEEP.

CALLER IS REPORTING A SPILL OF MERCURY AT A HOSPITAL THAT WAS BEING REMODELED. A PLUMBING CONTRACTOR WAS REMOVING OLD PLUMBING WHEN MERCURY SPILLED UNTO THE FLOOR WHICH MADE A 4 BY 5 INCH PUDDLE. THE NEXT DAY THE AREA REMAINED TAPED OFF AND A HAZMAT CARRIER CAME AND FOUND MORE MERCURY AND TOLD EMPLOYEES AND CONTRACTORS THAT THE MERCURY WAS ABOVE SAFE STANDARDS AND MADE EVERYONE LEAVE. CALLER IS CONCERNED BECAUSE THEY HAVE NOT SEEN HAZMAT AGAIN SINCE THAT FIRST DAY AND THAT THE AREA IS STILL TAPED OFF WHILE CONTRACTORS ARE WORKING.
